desc:
⛏️ Vehicle based mining game

🤝 Coop based gameplay

👀 First person clickable cabins

📖 Reading guide book (tool) recommended

⚖️ RULES ⚖️
 - Do not abuse physics for griefing other players
 - Do not road rage
 - Do not block roads/crushers
 - Do not exploit
 - Do not afk farm/use macros 

>General keybinds (In game rebindable)
  [W] Throttle
  [S] Service brake
  [E] Start / Stop engine
  [V] UnFlip
  [R]/[F] Shift gear
  [T]/[G] Hydraulic Brake

>Hauler Specific
  [Y]/[H] Dumping 

>Wheel loader Specific
  [↑]/[↓] Raise / Lower boom
  [←]/[→] Tilt bucket

>Excavator Specific
  [↑]/[↓] Raise / Lower boom
  [←]/[→] Tilt bucket
  [U]/[J] Extend/ Retract stick
  [H]/[K] Pivot Turret

>Drill Specific
  [↑]/[↓] Raise / Lower drill column
